observations.text: Noor switched to a vegan diet after watching a documentary about dairy farming.
Sam has been afraid of heights since a childhood fall from a ladder.
Sam's doctor told him he needs regular cardio exercise for his heart health.
Sam started climbing at Riverside gym because his doctor said he needed cardio.
Noor's favorite cuisine is Ethiopian; she always orders the vegetable platter.
Dev borrowed Noor's tripod and promised to return it before the Lisbon trip.
Noor and Sam are planning a Lisbon trip in June for a friend's wedding.
Sam no longer climbs at Riverside; he switched to Harbor gym because it got too crowded.
Noor is allergic to peanuts, so she always checks restaurant menus carefully.
